# Ovinia
Ovinia are ruminant-like humanoids with a thick, fluffy coat of wool. They are a densely built, naturalistic people who often go without clothing, and an Ovinia's wool is their pride and joy.
## Benefits - Their insulating wool gives them [color=#1e90ff]25% less Blunt and Heat damage[/color]. - They digest slowly, becoming [color=#1e90ff]hungry and thirsty 25% slower[/color]. - Their hooved feet [color=#1e90ff]protect them from shards of glass[/color] and other sharp floor hazards.
## Downsides - They take [color=#ffa500]15% more Slash and Piercing damage[/color].
